Both pork belly and neck meat were juicy and clean without any unpleasant smell.
I keep reaching for the kimchi that I grill together because it goes well with the fat.

reviews.author: Hwang Min-sook

I visited Hanam Pork Restaurant after a long time wanting to eat proper meat, and now I understand why it is so crowded with people.

reviews.text: I recommend this if you are looking for a luxurious Korean restaurant in Myeongdong. reviews.author: Heesoo Lee
reviews.text:
I went to have a dinner course with my parents. I was worried that my parents would be uncomfortable because it was in the very crowded and hectic center of Myeongdong, but the moment I entered the restaurant, I was surprised by the quiet and calm atmosphere, as if I was completely disconnected from the outside world.

It was quiet and private enough to not feel the noise of Myeongdong at all, so it was perfect for having a private conversation with my parents throughout the meal.

The food was plated neatly, like a work of art, and the main steak was soft, so it was easy for seniors to eat it. It was a proud evening because I felt like I was treating my parents properly thanks to the staff's attentive service. Highly recommended if you are looking for a quiet and formal place for a family gathering in Myeongdong.

reviews.author: Eunhye Seol
reviews.text:
I came here to treat my parents to a meal, and it was unique because it was a steak eaten at a Korean restaurant, unlike a regular Western restaurant.

My parents also liked it more because they ate it with a familiar sauce made from soybean paste rather than an awkward sauce, and they were satisfied because they could get a taste of Korean food^0^

The course composition, from appetizers to desserts, was really neat and tidy, and it felt like they put a lot of effort into it. I was proud to hear that my parents said they felt like they were treated with sincerity.

Recommended for those who are treating important guests or are traveling and want to experience high-quality Korean food for the first time!

reviews.text:
Euljiro maturity level: the essence of premium pork belly

1. Atmosphere and interior

Sungseongdo, located in Euljiro, is a pork specialty restaurant with a modern yet luxurious atmosphere. Natural light comes in through the wide windows, creating a bright and pleasant atmosphere, and the brick interior gives a sophisticated yet warm feeling. There is ample space between tables to allow for private dining, and individual flues are installed at each seat so smoke from grilling meat is discharged comfortably.

2. Menu composition and taste

The maturity level is characterized by a deeper flavor and softer texture as the pork belly is aged.
• Pork Belly: This is the most popular menu item, and thanks to the aging process, it has an excellent balance of fat and lean meat. It's crispy on the outside and moist on the inside, so you can enjoy the rich flavor of the meat.
• Pork neck: Excellent for its moderate marbling and umami that deepens as you chew it.
• Gabri Sal: It has a chewy texture and juicy texture, so it is recommended as a delicacy.
• Grilled aged Korean beef: It is attractive that you can taste not only pork but also high-quality Korean beef.

To maximize the taste of the meat, it is served with various seasonings such as wasabi, salt, and ssamjang.

3. Service and convenience
• Self-service bar operation: It is convenient to take basic side dishes and sauces freely from the self-service bar.
• Use of charcoal grill: Traditional charcoal grill is used to maximize the natural flavor of the meat.
• Friendly service from staff: A service is provided to grill the meat yourself and guide you on the most delicious way to eat it.

4. Price and cost-effectiveness

Considering the quality of the meat, the price is a bit high, but considering the deep flavor of the aged meat and the luxurious atmosphere, it is quite satisfactory. The price of pork belly and pork neck is in the high 10,000 to 20,000 won range per serving, and Korean beef is priced at a slightly higher price range.

5. Overall review

Euljiro Sungdo is the best place to taste premium pork belly. If you want to enjoy the deep flavor and juiciness of aged pork belly, this is a place worth visiting.
✔ Recommended for: People who want to truly taste aged pork belly, couples or groups looking for a restaurant with a good atmosphere
✔ Intention to revisit: ★★★★★ (4/5)
✔ Recommended menu: Aged pork belly

If you are looking for high-quality aged pork belly in Euljiro, the level of maturity is the best choice!

Enjoy fresh and delicious seafood dishes at Wandodaek Pocha!

reviews.author: D.W.C Love
reviews.text: Located in Myeongdong, Pocharo mainly sells seafood, but it also sells a variety of things. The taste is spicy, the price is a bit expensive, and the portion is average. Strangely enough, Myeongdong doesn't have any bars that can accommodate a large number of people, but the store here is large enough to accommodate a certain number of people. Restrooms are available in the building's shared restrooms and are separate for men and women.

reviews.author: DD PAPA
reviews.text: It's a small space with mostly multi-tasking seating, and there are two tables that can seat four people. The store opens at 6 p.m., and the ketch table opens at 7 p.m. on mobile phones, but there is a system where you can enter on time if you wait in advance on site. The menu for each day is announced through Instagram. I recommend trying the menu here that you don't normally eat. Mideodeokhoe had a good texture and taste even when eaten without anything. This is a menu you won’t see anywhere else. However, the quantity is quite small compared to the price. I intend to visit again.
